_README: Car wash broker source registry. Mirrors the veterinary rig's broker_codes.json pattern. site_prefix TCWM = The Car Wash Market (feeds thecarwashmarket.com). NEVER collides with dental's TDPM-, veterinary's TVM-, auto repair's TAM-, laundromat's TMM-, or optometry's TASM-. 'ref_prefix' is the source-scoped broker reference shown muted on cards. 'aggregator: true' sources are purged by the normalizer and MUST NEVER be added — BizBuySell, BizQuest, LoopNet, DealStream, and BusinessBroker.net are banned outright and never given an entry here.
